V. 30.
He ſhall receive an hundred fold, houſe, &c.—Not in the ſame Kind; for it will generally be with perſecutions: But in Value: An
••nd•ed fold more Happineſs than any or all of theſe did or 〈◊〉
•fford. But let it be obſerved, None is intitled to this Hap
•••••• but he that will accept of it with perſecutions.
